label: new raw rows
detail: One statement every 250 ms (SQLite's data_version) asks whether anything committed; while a match is followed, the raw rows after the last one pushed are then read.
The read model pushes those rows into an in-memory replay that runs the parser's own code.

label: hidden ids cut
detail: Unrevealed card ids in the opponent's hand and library are removed first; the keys are an allow-list of 37 paths. Marked in amber: a test fails if snapshot keys differ from it.
Joined with card facts and the record: the deck's past results against the opponent's colours, read from the file by statistics functions that MCP tools also call; sent only when it differs.

label: channel
detail: This path's only thread crossing: a channel send and a repaint request.
The renderer draws Library, Opponent, Record and Status, from display rules in the core library.
